verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a platform for orchestrating background tasks, AI agents and durable workflows. Its docs cover cron triggers, scheduled runs, webhooks and retry policies, so automations can run unattended. Community users corroborate it as a background task queue with a trigger-based flow UI. Missing for 10: the scheduled-run and cron pages appear only as titles with little detail, and there is no hands-on report of autonomous agent automations running in production.
